ApprovalRuleDetails.description: The ApprovalRuleDetails container displays and manages approval rule configuration including conditions, approvers, and rule metadata.

completeExample.title: Complete integration example
completeExample.intro: This example from the AEM boilerplate shows a complete implementation with authentication, permissions, and event handling:
keyPoints: **Authentication Check**: Redirects unauthenticated users before rendering
**Permission Validation**: Checks both B2B enablement and specific PO permissions
**URL Parameter Handling**: Extracts `ruleRef` from query string
**Event-Driven Updates**: Reacts to permission and authentication changes
**Graceful Redirects**: Routes users appropriately based on access level
**Initialization**: Imports initializer to set up the drop-in
